parts.t: INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY! Built in 2018, this fully tenanted fourplex offers an excellent turnkey investment in a convenient Penticton location. The property includes two spacious upper units with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, approximately 880 sq. ft. each, plus two lower units with 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom, approximately 680 sq. ft. each. All four units are individually metered, tenants pay their own utilities, and every unit includes in-suite laundry. Additional features include 3 parking stalls and a central location close to Safeway, Starbucks, Shoppers Drug Mart, BC Liquor Store and other everyday amenities.

v: Two 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom upper units and two 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom lower units.
All four units are separately metered, with tenants paying their own utilities.
Each of the four units includes its own in-suite laundry.
Steps from shopping, restaurants, transit and everyday amenities.
